Keepaway_minPouncesForSoloPlay.blurb: Min of RNG range for solo-play pounce count before exit (when cube never moves after game start).

Keepaway_maxPouncesForSoloPlay.blurb: Max of RNG range for solo-play pounce count before exit (when cube never moves after game start).

Keepaway_targetUnmovedGameEndTimeout_s.blurb: Seconds cube may stay unmoved while visible before bored get-out (0 disables). Skipped if cube never moved since game start.

Keepaway_noVisibleTargetGameEndTimeout_s.blurb: Seconds without a visible target before bored get-out (0 disables).

Keepaway_outOfPlayGameEndTimeout_s.blurb: Seconds target may remain out-of-play (Unready) before bored get-out while Stalking.

Keepaway_targetVisibleTimeout_s.blurb: Max age (s) of last observation to count the target as still visible (brief occlusion grace).

Keepaway_globalOffsetDist_mm.blurb: Added to all distance thresholds (in-play, pounce, mousetrap) to compensate anim vs physical distance.

Keepaway_inPlayDistance_mm.blurb: Intended in-play distance (mm) from JSON; not read by game logic after load.
Keepaway_inPlayDistance_mm.statusNote: MakeMemberTunable + JSON load only. isInPlay uses globalOffsetDist_mm + outOfPlayDistance_mm; inPlayDistance_mm never referenced after definition.

Keepaway_outOfPlayDistance_mm.blurb: Distance (mm) + globalOffset for isInPlay: closer than this → Ready posture; farther → Unready / out-of-play.
Keepaway_outOfPlayDistance_mm.statusNote: Despite the name, this is the only distance used for the in-play / out-of-play gate.

Keepaway_allowablePointingError_deg.blurb: If |angle to target| exceeds this (deg), Victor turns toward the cube while Stalking.

Keepaway_targetUnmovedCreepTimeout_s.blurb: Seconds target must be unmoved before isNotMoving; starts creep delay schedule.

Keepaway_creepDistanceMin_mm.blurb: Min random creep drive distance (mm) when closing on a still cube outside pounce range.

Keepaway_creepDistanceMax_mm.blurb: Max random creep drive distance (mm), also capped by remaining distance to pounce range.

Keepaway_creepDelayTimeMin_s.blurb: Min delay (s) after unmoved timeout / stalk start before a creep is allowed.

Keepaway_creepDelayTimeMax_s.blurb: Max delay (s) after unmoved timeout / stalk start before a creep is allowed.

Keepaway_pounceDelayTimeMin_s.blurb: Min delay (s) after entering pounce range / stalk start before a real pounce may fire.

Keepaway_pounceDelayTimeMax_s.blurb: Max delay (s) after entering pounce range / stalk start before a real pounce may fire.

Keepaway_basePounceChance.blurb: Initial pounce-vs-fakeout probability; reset to this after each real pounce.

Keepaway_pounceChanceIncrement.blurb: Added to pounceChance after each fakeout (clamped 0–1), making later pounces more likely.

Keepaway_nominalPounceDistance_mm.blurb: Distance (mm) + globalOffset for isInPounceRange and max creep toward target.

Keepaway_mousetrapPounceDistance_mm.blurb: Closer than this (mm + globalOffset): mousetrap path — immediate close pounce or backup.

Keepaway_probBackupInsteadOfMousetrap.blurb: Probability of CubePounceBackup instead of pounce/fakeout when target is in mousetrap range.

Keepaway_pounceSuccessPitchDiff_deg.blurb: Pitch rise (deg) above pre-pounce pitch that counts the pounce as a hit.

Keepaway_excitementIncPerHit.blurb: Per successful pounce, increase excitement/frustration scale (toward excited exit).

Keepaway_maxProbExitExcited.blurb: Caps how far excitement scale may go above 1.0; exit prob on hit = scale − 1.

Keepaway_frustrationIncPerMiss.blurb: Per missed pounce, decrease excitement/frustration scale (toward frustrated exit).

Keepaway_maxProbExitFrustrated.blurb: Caps how far scale may go below 1.0; exit prob on miss = 1 − scale.

Keepaway_minProbToExit.blurb: Floor on the random exit roll: rolls below this are clamped up, so low exit probs rarely win.
Keepaway_minProbToExit.statusNote: If exitRoll < minProbToExit, exitRoll is set to minProbToExit before comparing to probExit.

Keepaway_baseProbReact.blurb: Starting and post-reaction hit/miss reaction probability (CubePounceWinHand / LoseHand).

Keepaway_minProbToReact.blurb: Lower bound of RNG sample compared to hit/miss react probability (lower → harder to react).

Keepaway_probReactIncrement.blurb: On skipped reaction, add this to hit/miss react probability (capped by probReactMax).

Keepaway_probReactMax.blurb: Cap for hit/miss reaction probability after increments.

Keepaway_useProxForDistance.blurb: JSON/console flag intended to select prox vs vision distance; never read after load.
Keepaway_useProxForDistance.statusNote: Parsed and MakeMemberTunable-registered only; no read sites in BehaviorKeepaway or elsewhere.
